y-m-09-04.title: Ukuqagela isisindo sika-apula elilodwa nge-balance scale
y-m-09-04.topic: Isisindo (g) nokuthola ibanga ngokuqhathanisa kwi-balance scale
y-m-09-04.goal: Noma ungakwazi ukwazi inani elinembile, sho ibanga lesisindo kusukela emiphumeleni yokuqhathanisa, nciphisa ibanga ngokuqaphela okusha, bese ucabanga ngomkhawulo wokuthi amathuluzi onawo manje angakwazi yini ukuliminyaza kakhulu.
y-m-09-04.material:
Beka u-apula epanini elilodwa le-balance scale nezisindo kwelinye ipani ukuze uqhathanise. Uhlangothi olusindayo luyehla, futhi uma izisindo zilingana, kuyalingana. Kunezisindo eziningana ezingu-50 g, 100 g, 200 g, nezingu-500 g ngayinye. Sithi kunama-apula amaningana anesisindo esifanayo ngqo, futhi isisindo sika-apula e-1 siyinombolo yemvelo nge-g.
Ukuqaphela 1: u-apula e-1 no-izisindo ezimbili ezingu-200 g → uhlangothi lukapula luhlile.
Ukuqaphela 2: u-apula e-1 nesisindo esisodwa esingu-500 g → uhlangothi lwesisindo luhlile.
